international.title: Leaders meet in Dublin amid search for lead EU negotiator for peace talks with Russia - Europe live
international.summary: Ukraine and Russia have agreed to expand next round of negotiations to include European countries in Dublin EU leaders will continue talks on their diplomatic and financial support for Ukraine today, after Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged them to “pay attention” to Vladimir Putin’s demands on security. “There is no need to reinvent the wheel. Europe had a functioning European security architecture until it was first, gradually undermined, and ultimately destroyed by Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.” “In terms of the wider point, there was a very strong feeling that you know, Russian demands to put the question of European security architecture or European security arrangements into this negotiation – that is not up for negotiation.. . It is for Europe to decide its own arrangements. Europe and Europe alone. And again, I am talking in the wider sense when I say that.” Continue reading...
